answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a time-locked escrow that only unlocks after verified work, like a walnut shell guarding its kernel: a hollow identity with no stake earns nothing, while a real agent builds reputation over time. Spinning up thousands of fake agents then means locking real capital per identity, and any detected fraud burns the stake, so the attack costs more than the rewards it could steal. An ivory-tower design trusting self-declared identity fails; escrowed stake makes sybil creation expensive and verifiable.
